title: The Mist Age - Adversaries Advanced
description: More on the Daggerheart adversary sheet: a Profile tab with the adversary's religion and the organizations it belongs to (picked from The Mist Age - Geopolitics organizations), and feature categories the GM sets up in the module settings (e.g. psychic, social) — each one a tab of its own, and a feature's Settings tab picks which one it belongs to.

recommends.reason: Organizations to pick on the Profile tab, and religion names to suggest.
